name: Temporary Residence for the Purpose of Business

requirements.blocker_text: A functioning limited company (with incorporation documents) or a business plan.
Personal bank account confirmation of at least EUR 2,270 (12x the Slovak living-wage figure).
For a limited company: business account confirmation of at least EUR 18,909 (100x the Slovak living-wage figure).

evidence_required.document: Company incorporation certificate and shareholder minutes, or business plan
Personal and/or business bank account balance confirmations
Apostilled and translated criminal record certificates

outcome.duration_length: for the estimated duration of the business, up to a maximum of 3 years

sources.title: AKMV (Slovak immigration law firm) -- temporary residence for business: EUR 2,270 personal / EUR 18,909 business-account financial-security thresholds (tied to the statutory living-wage figure), 3-year maximum duration, ~EUR 236.50 administrative fee, in-person application at the local police department

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Slovakia). STATUS: DRAFT -- tier-3 law-firm sourced; Slovakia's Ministry of Interior/Foreign Police pages, which would be the tier-1 source, were not reachable to sufficient depth in this pass. NOTABLE STRUCTURAL FEATURE: the financial thresholds are pegged to Slovakia's statutory living-wage figure (zivotne minimum) at 12x (personal) and 100x (business) multiples, rather than being flat fixed amounts -- meaning these EUR figures will drift as the living-wage reference updates, similar in kind to formula-pegged thresholds this dataset has flagged elsewhere (e.g. Germany's Blue Card salary threshold pegged to the pension contribution ceiling), though this dataset does not have a national-variables file for Slovakia's living wage to formally track the peg. No job-creation requirement was found -- unlike some other countries' investor routes, Slovakia's business-residence route does not appear to require hiring local staff, only demonstrated financial capacity and a genuine business plan or existing company. pr_after_months/citizenship_after_months inferred the same way as sk_work_permit.json.
